mapper.select: select t.id, t.org_id as orgId, t.signature_id as signatureId, ss.sign_name as signName, t.template_name as templateName, t.template_content as templateContent, t.template_item as templateItem, t.template_code as templateCode, t.template_status as templateStatus, t.template_type as templateType, t.template_length as templateLength, t.tag_input_value as tagInputValue, t.remark, t.sense, t.crt_user as crtUser from sms_template_set t left join sms_signature_set ss on t.signature_id=ss.id where t.id = #{id}
